display_title: Want to Go Grocery Shopping Together?
description:
Yang-Eun, a solo dweller with life skills who only targets products nearing their expiration date, and Woo-Seok, a minimalist who calculates every aspect of life in terms of efficiency. From the day they shared a buy-one-get-one-free strawberry deal, their budding romance... no, their grocery shopping begins!
